verdict.rationale: Retell documents connecting single/multi-prompt voice agents to remote MCP servers so the agent can call the server's tools mid-call (retell-docs-6/23/36), directly matching the story, and this is distinct from Retell's own client-side MCP server for building agents. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of mid-call MCP tool invocation in production (only first-party docs and a probe of the client-facing MCP server, not the agent-as-MCP-client tool-call path, are available).
